headline: Approved prior meeting minutes and held a public hearing on Community Development Block Grant program year 51 plans.
summary: Public comments were taken on the draft CAPA report. A public hearing covered Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) goals, accomplishments, and next steps. The only formal decision was approval of the prior meeting's minutes.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the August 12, 2026 meeting.

decision_evidence.quote: Daveyanah Taylor made a motion to approve the minutes. Jameka Jeffries seconded the motion. Motion approved.

9. NEW BUSINESS   
 
 
  a. Community Development Block Grant Public Hearing  
  Camile Samuels executed each item on the Public Hearing agenda: 
• Explain the Purpose of the Public Hearing  
• Provide an Overview of CDBG Program 
o After the overview, public was notified that this can be found online and 
comments can be submitted to CDBG@hamden.com 
• Review the Program Year 51(PY51) planned activities 
o Camile reviewed Consolidated Plan Goals 2025-2029: 
• Increase access to affordable housing 
• Increase access to public services/slash infrastructure 
• Economic development and community revitalization 
• Program Administration 
• Inform on the PY51 Accomplishments Met 
o Camile reported that as of 8-31-26, the Mayor signed an agreement, 
and can move forward in spending the money from the CDBG grant 
agreement with HUD
